All figures aggregate event-level CAD/phone records with DuckDB views (`duckdb-lab/sql/`).
Descriptives use medians and IQRs throughout because response-time columns are
right-skewed; means are reported only alongside medians. Compliance percentages
are simple rates against the thresholds above; binomial p-values, where shown,
come from the Python/R/Julia stats layer. Outliers are consensus flags (≥2 of
IQR fence, |z| > 3, MAD, p01/p99). Forecasts are seasonal-naive baselines unless
the figure notes an ETS/SARIMA model, and every forecast is accompanied by its
rolling-origin backtest RMSE.
